title: Onboard halo-13b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata & changelog automation
author: Arjun Mehta
description: Onboard halo-13b v1.0 to the model registry with validated performance profiles, updated metadata, and automation to generate changelog entries for releases. Motivation: halo-13b is a community model that performs well on our internal evals for instruction-following and chat workloads; customers requested a mature perf profile so we can offer clear guidance on latency/cost and proper quantization options. This PR includes: 1) New model metadata (model card, license, config mapping) and canonical model id 'halo-13b:v1.0'. 2) Performance profiles for common sequence length and batch-size distributions (in float32, fp16, and int8-quantized profiles). Profiles include median p95 latencies and tokens/sec throughput measured on our standard A100-80GB and RTX-6000 testbeds. 3) Changelog automation hooks: a script that converts model-registry metadata updates into a release note fragment and appends to the changelog bucket; integrates with existing release tooling to auto-generate the model section in release notes. 4) Registry validation: CI checks that validate profile schema and ensure required metadata fields are present. 5) Small docs updates and an example perf dashboard config. Testing: perf profiles were generated with the perf-canary harness across 3 runs, results averaged, and sanity-checked against existing Aurora/Orion baselines. CI: added a smoke job to run schema validator and a lightweight latency probe against the canary infra. Rollout: model is added to the catalog as 'beta' and pinned to v1.0; we will monitor quality metrics and promote once we have 24h of stable traffic. See commit summaries and files changed for details.
